title: Choose the visual world for CoopRadar
question: The roll assigned Registered Mail. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Registered Mail
options.lineage: Canadian post office counters, envelopes, postmarks and tracking slips
options.thesis: Every application is a letter you send, and every job wears a postmark.
options.viewport: A solid postal red top bar, a white job list with no card boxes, each row stamped with a round postmark showing its city and closing date, details panel on the right like the front of an envelope.
options.risk: If the postmark gets overused it turns into a costume instead of a date badge.

raised.raise: No card boxes: rows and panels are split by type size and thin rules only.
Colour owns whole regions: the red bar and the tinted filter strip run full width.
Time is drawn to scale: a deadline bar shows the real days left.
The list header names the range you are looking at, like 1 to 25 of 2,903.

options.label: Transit Line
options.lineage: Canadian subway and LRT wayfinding maps
options.thesis: Your co-op search drawn as a subway line, with each stage as a stop.
options.viewport: Black top bar with yellow active line, job list with coloured line markers per term, tracker drawn as stations from Saved to Offer.
options.risk: Transit maps are a common metaphor, so it can feel familiar.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Hierarchy by size alone on bare paper.
options.risk: Students do not see themselves in a type foundry.
options.case: Loses on both: no link to students or co-op.
options.kept: No card boxes, hierarchy by type scale and rules.

options.label: Dance Score
options.case: Loses on both: foreign to the audience and the task.
options.kept: Deadline bars drawn to real length.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Flat colour lobes own each area.
options.case: Loses on both: hurts scanning hundreds of jobs.
options.kept: Colour owns whole regions, not small accents.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: Guide words name the span in view.
options.risk: Old book look reads as dusty.
options.case: Loses on both: wrong era for students.
options.kept: The list header names the range in view.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean job board like LinkedIn or Indeed, done carefully.
canonCard.viewport: White header, search bar, job list and details panel.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other job board, which is what you said you want to leave.
